nodes.label: EDITOR-UTILITIES-001 Image utility suite
nodes.rationale: Approved contract; activation still requires conformance and specialist/platform evidence.

nodes.label: EU-001 The editor start surface
nodes.rationale: The editor start surface MUST make every utility in `utility-catalog.json` reachable or record an approved platform disposition. Missing host services MUST be explained and MUST NOT crash utility startup.

nodes.label: EU-002 Screen Color Picker
nodes.rationale: Screen Color Picker MUST request required capture permission, magnify the sampled area, expose coordinates and canonical color values, support keyboard cancellation, and copy only after explicit user action.

nodes.label: EU-003 QR generation
nodes.rationale: QR generation MUST validate non-empty content and output size, render a deterministic scannable preview, and support explicit copy, save, and upload through host services with typed failures.

nodes.label: EU-004 QR scanning
nodes.rationale: QR scanning MUST support Screen, Region, and Image File modes, obtain capture/file consent, validate and limit input, return zero, one, or multiple decoded values distinctly, and never upload sampled pixels.

nodes.label: EU-005 Hash Checker
nodes.rationale: Hash Checker MUST offer CRC32, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512, default to SHA-256, stream files without unbounded memory, expose progress/cancellation, and compare two results using constant-time equality where security-sensitive use is claimed.

nodes.label: EU-006 Hash results
nodes.rationale: Hash results MUST identify the algorithm and file unambiguously; MD5 and SHA-1 MUST be labelled unsuitable for security verification and MUST NOT be recommended for authenticity decisions.

nodes.label: EU-007 Icon Converter
nodes.rationale: Icon Converter MUST accept a validated image, offer 16, 32, 48, 64, 128, and 256-pixel entries, support 8-bit palette and 32-bit true-color modes, retain alpha as permitted, and write a structurally valid `.ico` only after at least one size is selected.

nodes.label: EU-008 Image Comparison
nodes.rationale: Image Comparison MUST load two independent validated images, report size/format incompatibility, expose an accessible before/after slider or equivalent, and MUST NOT modify, save, or upload either image.

nodes.label: EU-009 Background Removal
nodes.rationale: Background Removal MUST use an explicitly selected local model and Auto, CPU, or GPU device policy, validate model provenance and tensor shapes, show model/device/setup/inference status, and retain the source on failure.

nodes.label: EU-010 Background-removal models
nodes.rationale: Background-removal models MUST NOT be downloaded or executed from untrusted locations silently. Model directory access, optional download, license, integrity, size, and network behavior require explicit disclosure.

nodes.label: EU-011 Background-removal preview and save
nodes.rationale: Background-removal preview and save MUST preserve source dimensions and color, produce defined alpha, support cancellation, and distinguish model, device, memory, inference, and output failures.

nodes.label: EU-012 Video Converter
nodes.rationale: Video Converter MUST expose the 15 codec choices recorded in the utility catalog, input, output folder/name, quality or bitrate where applicable, progress, cancellation, and optional open-folder behavior.

nodes.label: EU-013 Hardware video codecs
nodes.rationale: Hardware video codecs MUST be shown only when usable or must fail with an actionable fallback. Command arguments MUST be structured or safely escaped, MUST NOT permit injection, and output MUST be written atomically.

nodes.label: EU-014 The converter
nodes.rationale: The converter MUST validate container/codec/input compatibility, reserve a non-conflicting output path, preserve the input, delete incomplete output on cancellation where safe, and distinguish success, cancellation, and failure in its host result.

nodes.label: EU-015 Utility file and screen inputs are private user data. No utility
nodes.norm_label: eu-015 utility file and screen inputs are private user data. no utility
nodes.rationale: Utility file and screen inputs are private user data. No utility MUST send them over a network, retain them after the declared session, or add them to diagnostics without explicit user action and a separately approved integration contract.

nodes.label: EU-016 Utility windows
nodes.rationale: Utility windows MUST use native accessible controls, visible focus, keyboard traversal, descriptive busy/error state, cancel/close semantics, high contrast, and native file/capture permission surfaces on all platforms.

nodes.label: EU-017 Each utility
nodes.rationale: Each utility MUST own cancellation and dispose images, streams, models, sessions, and temporary files deterministically. Closing a busy window MUST cancel or explicitly confirm background continuation.

nodes.label: EU-018 Conformance
nodes.rationale: Conformance MUST cover each catalog item, command, algorithm, codec, input mode, success, cancellation, corrupt input, permission denial, missing host, unsupported hardware, resource limit, and output failure.

nodes.label: EU-019 The hidden Konami-code shader animation
nodes.norm_label: eu-019 the hidden konami-code shader animation
nodes.rationale: The hidden Konami-code shader animation MUST remain inventoried but MUST NOT become required product behavior until the product owner records a preserve, correct, or omit decision after accessibility, performance, security, discoverability, and maintenance review.

nodes.label: WFCAT-001
nodes.rationale: Every workflow-ledger row linked to this package MUST retain its stable ledger ID and receive an approved action ID, purpose, input schema, output schema, side-effect class, authority, cancellation points, failure behavior, and Windows, macOS, and Linux disposition before activation.

nodes.label: WFCAT-002
nodes.rationale: A workflow invocation MUST create one traceable execution with a stable ID, start time, origin, effective settings snapshot, ordered step results, terminal state, and redacted diagnostics.

nodes.label: WFCAT-003
nodes.rationale: GUI, hotkey, tray, CLI, MCP, watch-folder, and automation invocations of the same action MUST use the same semantic request and result. Entry points MAY add presentation but MUST NOT invent different behavior.

nodes.label: WFCAT-004
nodes.rationale: The engine MUST distinguish success, partial success, skipped, cancelled, permission denied, validation failure, unavailable dependency, transient failure, and permanent failure. A step MUST NOT report success before its promised durable side effects complete.

nodes.label: WFCAT-005
nodes.rationale: Ordered post-capture and post-upload actions MUST follow the approved ordering graph. A failure MUST apply the action's declared continue, stop, retry, compensate, or request-user policy and preserve prior results.

nodes.label: WFCAT-006
nodes.rationale: Cancellation MUST be cooperative, idempotent, and observable. It MUST stop new side effects, await or safely detach non-cancellable native work, retain completed outputs, and report resources that require cleanup.

nodes.label: WFCAT-007
nodes.rationale: Capture and recording workflows MUST request platform permission before acquisition, expose cancellation, and preserve the accepted capture or recording capability's monitor, DPI, cursor, audio, and degraded-mode rules.

nodes.label: WFCAT-008
nodes.rationale: Clipboard workflows MUST validate available formats, avoid replacing clipboard content until the promised result is ready, preserve privacy classification, and return an explicit unsupported-content result.

nodes.label: WFCAT-009
nodes.rationale: File, folder, save, delete, index, external-program, and explorer actions MUST resolve canonical paths, prevent unintended traversal, handle collisions by approved policy, and require confirmation for destructive or authority-expanding operations.

nodes.label: WFCAT-010
nodes.rationale: Upload and URL actions MUST use the approved destination and credential authority, report progress and remote results, avoid leaking secrets, and distinguish local success from remote publication success.

nodes.label: WFCAT-011
nodes.rationale: Image, OCR, QR, hash, color, combine, split, thumbnail, effect, and editor actions MUST declare accepted input media, output representation, metadata policy, deterministic parameters, and failure behavior.

nodes.label: WFCAT-012
nodes.rationale: Recording control actions MUST target an explicit current session, be idempotent where safe, reject invalid state transitions, and preserve recoverable output on stop, abort, or encoder failure as specified by the recording contract.

nodes.label: WFCAT-013
nodes.rationale: Application-control actions such as opening views, disabling hotkeys, or exiting MUST respect current modal work, unsaved state, agent authority, and destructive confirmation. Headless entry points MUST return an actionable result when presentation is required.

nodes.label: WFCAT-014
nodes.rationale: Concurrent invocations MUST declare whether they serialize, coalesce, reject, or execute independently. Shared clipboard, capture, recording, file, history, and credential resources MUST have deterministic arbitration with no silent last-writer-wins behavior.

nodes.label: WFCAT-015
nodes.rationale: Retry MUST be bounded, cancellable, and restricted to operations declared idempotent or protected by an idempotency key. The execution record MUST distinguish attempts without duplicating user-visible results.

nodes.label: WFCAT-016
nodes.rationale: Workflow definitions and presets MUST be versioned, use stable action IDs, validate completely before execution, retain compatible unknown fields, and produce an explicit migration or unsupported-action result.

nodes.label: WFCAT-017
nodes.rationale: Logs, history, notifications, and progress surfaces MUST expose the same terminal state and output references while redacting secrets and private content. Notifications MUST NOT claim completion for partial failure.

nodes.label: WFCAT-018
nodes.rationale: Activation MUST include deterministic scenarios for every linked action family, ordering and failure matrices, permission denial, cancellation at each side-effect boundary, concurrent invocation, retry/idempotency, malformed definitions, and execution on all supported platform adapters.

nodes.rationale: Owned rotation preview validates the complete represented group and commits once; no shared schema or acceptance change.

nodes.rationale: Guarded stroke/default changes retain one-step history; capture defaults remain local and global persistence requires admission.

nodes.label: EDITOR-CANVAS-001 Canvas and image operations
nodes.rationale: Approved contract; activation still requires conformance and specialist/platform evidence.

nodes.label: EC-001 New Image
nodes.rationale: New Image MUST create a document from validated dimensions, background/alpha choice, color profile, and optional initial pixels. Cancel or invalid input MUST NOT replace the current document.

nodes.label: EC-002 Open
nodes.rationale: Open MUST support native file selection and explicit recent-file selection, validate before replacing the session, apply orientation once, preserve alpha and color metadata, and report unsupported or corrupt input.

nodes.label: EC-003 Opening a URL
nodes.rationale: Opening a URL MAY be offered, but MUST require explicit user action, HTTPS by default, download and decode limits, redirect limits, content validation, cancellation, and a clear local-copy/privacy outcome.

nodes.label: EC-004 Insert Image
nodes.rationale: Insert Image MUST accept a validated file, clipboard image, or optional screen capture, create one editable image annotation, preserve alpha and aspect ratio, and commit one history operation. Dialog bypass preferences MUST NOT bypass validation.

nodes.label: EC-005 Zoom In, Zoom Out, Reset Zoom, Zoom to Fit, wheel/pinch zoom, and pan
nodes.norm_label: ec-005 zoom in, zoom out, reset zoom, zoom to fit, wheel/pinch zoom, and pan
nodes.rationale: Zoom In, Zoom Out, Reset Zoom, Zoom to Fit, wheel/pinch zoom, and pan MUST modify only viewport state. They MUST NOT change document pixels, annotation coordinates, history, or dirty state.

nodes.label: EC-006 Viewport transforms
nodes.rationale: Viewport transforms MUST keep the pointer's logical image point stable where native convention permits, expose the zoom value, prevent non-finite scales, and retain usable scroll/pan access at minimum and maximum.

nodes.label: EC-007 Crop Image and the Crop annotation tool
nodes.norm_label: ec-007 crop image and the crop annotation tool
nodes.rationale: Crop Image and the Crop annotation tool MUST share one normalized retained rectangle. Commit MUST update dimensions and transform or remove annotations under a documented intersection policy in one history operation.

nodes.label: EC-008 Auto Crop
nodes.rationale: Auto Crop MUST derive deterministic bounds from explicit border, alpha, color-distance, and tolerance rules. An unchanged image MUST produce a no-op and MUST NOT add history.

nodes.label: EC-009 Resize Image
nodes.rationale: Resize Image MUST distinguish pixel dimensions from display scale, preserve aspect ratio when locked, validate interpolation and limits, and transform annotation geometry consistently when annotations are retained.

nodes.label: EC-010 Resize Canvas
nodes.rationale: Resize Canvas MUST define anchor, added-area fill or alpha, crop behavior, and annotation translation independently of pixel resampling.

nodes.label: EC-011 Rotate 90 degrees clockwise/counter-clockwise, Rotate 180, custom rotation, Flip Horizontal, and Flip Vertical
nodes.norm_label: ec-011 rotate 90 degrees clockwise/counter-clockwise, rotate 180, custom rotation, flip horizontal, and flip vertical
nodes.rationale: Rotate 90 degrees clockwise/counter-clockwise, Rotate 180, custom rotation, Flip Horizontal, and Flip Vertical MUST transform pixels, canvas, annotations, directional assets, and coordinates as one atomic operation.

nodes.label: EC-012 Custom rotation previews
nodes.rationale: Custom rotation previews MUST be cancellable and MUST expose angle, interpolation, canvas expansion/cropping, and background rules. Commit MUST produce one deterministic history entry.

nodes.label: EC-013 Background composition
nodes.rationale: Background composition MUST support transparent, solid, gradient, and image choices plus validated margin, padding, smart padding, corner radius, and shadow. Background assets MUST follow the same safety and durability rules as inserted images.

nodes.label: EC-014 Flatten
nodes.rationale: Flatten MUST composite source, background, and visible annotations into a new immutable source, clear only the objects represented in that composite, preserve color/alpha policy, and be fully undoable until history is intentionally discarded.

nodes.label: EC-015 Clear Annotations and Clear Image/Document
nodes.norm_label: ec-015 clear annotations and clear image/document
nodes.rationale: Clear Annotations and Clear Image/Document MUST be distinct, explicitly labelled operations. Destructive clear of pixels or replacement of a dirty document MUST use the session confirmation and recovery rules.

nodes.label: EC-016 Image comparison
nodes.rationale: Image comparison MUST accept two validated images, align them using a declared size policy, provide an accessible slider or equivalent comparison, and MUST NOT mutate either source.

nodes.label: EC-017 All canvas operations
nodes.rationale: All canvas operations MUST enforce finite dimensions and resource limits, expose progress/cancellation when costly, preserve session atomicity, and pass the vectors in `test-vectors.json` on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

nodes.label: EE-006 Effects that change image or canvas dimensions
nodes.norm_label: ee-006 effects that change image or canvas dimensions
nodes.rationale: Effects that change image or canvas dimensions MUST use the coordinate, annotation, and history rules in `EDITOR-CANVAS-001`; their browser entry MUST NOT bypass those rules.

nodes.label: EDITOR-OUTPUT-ACTIONS-001
nodes.rationale: Approved contract; activation still requires conformance and specialist/platform evidence.

nodes.label: EDITOR-OUTPUT-ACTIONS-001 Output and task actions
nodes.rationale: Approved contract; activation still requires conformance and specialist/platform evidence.

nodes.label: EO-001 Every output action
nodes.rationale: Every output action MUST render from one immutable document snapshot and MUST declare whether annotations and backgrounds are included. A concurrent edit MUST NOT produce a mixed or partially rendered result.

nodes.label: EO-002 Copy Image
nodes.rationale: Copy Image MUST place an interoperable native image representation on the clipboard, preserve alpha where supported, disclose any format loss, and MUST NOT clear dirty state or close the editor.

nodes.label: EO-003 Save
nodes.rationale: Save MUST use the current durable path only after prior path validation. Save As MUST use a native accessible picker and MUST NOT change the current path until a complete successful write.

nodes.label: EO-004 User-facing raster Save As
nodes.rationale: User-facing raster Save As MUST offer PNG, JPEG, and WebP with explicit alpha, quality, extension, and overwrite behavior as recorded in `format-disposition.json`. AVIF, GIF, and BMP MUST NOT be claimed solely because a helper or changelog mentions an encoder.

nodes.label: EO-005 Saves
nodes.rationale: Saves MUST use a same-directory temporary file and atomic replace where supported, preserve the previous destination on encode/write failure, and report destination, format, and recoverability without exposing private path data in telemetry.

nodes.label: EO-007 Upload
nodes.rationale: Upload MUST require an explicit host service and user action, render one snapshot, expose destination and privacy implications, support cancellation, and return a typed result. Failure MUST NOT close the session.

nodes.label: EO-008 Print
nodes.rationale: Print MUST use a native print flow, expose printer, page, scale, orientation, color, and cancellation, and MUST NOT mutate or save the document.

nodes.label: EO-009 Pin to Screen
nodes.rationale: Pin to Screen MUST hand one owned snapshot to an approved native pin service. Closing, moving, or scaling the pinned view MUST NOT affect the editor document, and unsupported platforms require an approved disposition.

nodes.label: EO-010 Set as Wallpaper
nodes.rationale: Set as Wallpaper MUST show the target display/layout choice, obtain confirmation, use a platform service, retain or disclose generated files, and return a typed success/failure result without changing the document.

nodes.label: EO-011 Continue in task mode
nodes.rationale: Continue in task mode MUST return an owned rendered result and the `Continue` outcome exactly once. Auto-copy and auto-close preferences MUST run only after the result is ready and MUST report partial failures distinctly.

nodes.label: EO-012 Cancel in task mode
nodes.rationale: Cancel in task mode MUST return the `Cancel` outcome without a rendered result or external side effect. If the document is dirty, discard confirmation MUST follow the session close policy.

nodes.label: EO-013 Exit in standalone mode
nodes.rationale: Exit in standalone mode MUST distinguish Save, Discard, and Cancel, keep the editor open on cancelled or failed Save, and MUST NOT treat a host callback return as success unless its success contract is satisfied.

nodes.label: EO-014 Host callbacks for copy, save, save as, print, pin, upload, task completion, and close
nodes.norm_label: eo-014 host callbacks for copy, save, save as, print, pin, upload, task completion, and close
nodes.rationale: Host callbacks for copy, save, save as, print, pin, upload, task completion, and close MUST declare ownership, thread, cancellation, lifetime, error, and reentrancy semantics. Missing callbacks MUST disable or explain the affected action rather than silently doing nothing.

nodes.label: EO-015 Output actions
nodes.rationale: Output actions MUST expose accessible names, shortcuts, busy and disabled state, progress, completion, failure, and retry. A shortcut MUST have the same confirmation and security behavior as its visible action.

nodes.label: EO-016 Conformance
nodes.rationale: Conformance MUST cover success, cancellation, permission denial, unsupported service, encoder failure, disk-full, overwrite refusal, callback exception, and raster/sidecar split outcomes on every supported platform.

nodes.label: D-AND-001 Android toolkit and OS baseline
nodes.norm_label: d-and-001 android toolkit and os baseline
nodes.rationale: Compose is the current native Android UI toolkit, and API 29 is the first level with scoped storage as the default model the contract's saving rules assume.

nodes.norm_label: d-base-001 reference baseline and full parity

nodes.label: D-CON-001 Contract schema, versioning, and tooling

nodes.label: D-GIT-001 Progressive commit and final push policy
nodes.norm_label: d-git-001 progressive commit and final push policy

nodes.label: D-IOS-001 iOS and iPadOS toolkit and OS baseline
nodes.norm_label: d-ios-001 ios and ipados toolkit and os baseline
nodes.rationale: SwiftUI matches D-MAC-001 so Apple-platform engineers share idioms. iOS cannot capture other applications' screens on demand, so the contract records a degraded region-capture disposition instead of pretending otherwise.

nodes.label: D-LIN-002 Linux distro-native editions
nodes.rationale: Because behavior is fixed by the English contract and verified by shared vectors, each Linux desktop can receive an application that follows its own conventions without forking the product. The Qt reference edition keeps one release-blocking Linux path while distro-native editions mature.

nodes.label: D-MAC-001 macOS SwiftUI/AppKit boundary and OS baseline
nodes.norm_label: d-mac-001 macos swiftui/appkit boundary and os baseline
nodes.rationale: SwiftUI is production-ready on 14+ and matches the agent-native, declarative implementation style. AppKit remains mandatory for overlay windows and menu-bar-only operation. Raising the floor from 12.3 avoids spending the implementation on SwiftUI backports.

nodes.label: D-MOB-001 Native mobile targets
nodes.rationale: A contract written in English and verified by shared vectors lets phones and tablets receive truly native applications that name, edit, and publish captures exactly as the desktop does, while platform limits are recorded as dispositions instead of silent gaps.

nodes.norm_label: d-own-001 product contract ownership and approval authority

nodes.norm_label: d-vid-001 native videoeditor and media tools

nodes.label: D-WIN-001 Windows framework and OS baseline
nodes.norm_label: d-win-001 windows framework and os baseline
nodes.rationale: WinUI 3 is the current Windows desktop UI stack and gives native Windows 11 accessibility and controls. Capture overlays, DXGI, and tray behavior still live in Win32/WinRT, so a hybrid is required rather than a pure WinUI app. WPF is in maintenance. MAUI and Avalonia would reintroduce a cross-platform UI layer, which this proposal exists to leave. C# is the language agents and the current Windows platform layer already use well; C++ is not required for native Windows behavior.

nodes.label: COMPATIBILITY-CATALOG-001
nodes.rationale: Approved contract; activation still requires conformance and specialist/platform evidence.

nodes.label: COMPATIBILITY-CATALOG-001 Persisted-data compatibility
nodes.rationale: Approved contract; activation still requires conformance and specialist/platform evidence.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-001 Every compatibility-ledger row linked to this package
nodes.norm_label: compcat-001 every compatibility-ledger row linked to this package
nodes.rationale: Every compatibility-ledger row linked to this package MUST retain its stable ledger ID and receive an approved format identity, version detection, import, export, round-trip, migration, rejection, unknown-field, corruption, security, and platform policy before activation.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-002 Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Compatibility MUST be derived from documented schemas, representative fixtures, and runtime observation. A source type declaration or serializer choice alone MUST NOT establish a compatibility promise.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-003 Import
nodes.rationale: Import MUST parse and validate into an isolated candidate model before changing live configuration, history, credentials, workflows, plugins, documents, or automation. Failure MUST identify the affected record without partially mutating unrelated live state.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-004 Import results
nodes.rationale: Import results MUST report fields or records retained, transformed, defaulted, quarantined, rejected, and ignored. Silent data loss is prohibited, and unsupported critical behavior MUST block acceptance.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-005 Unknown compatible fields
nodes.rationale: Unknown compatible fields MUST survive round-trip when their representation can be retained safely. Unknown executable, authority-bearing, secret, or structurally critical content MUST be quarantined or rejected.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-006 Export
nodes.rationale: Export MUST use an explicit version and target, write atomically, avoid machine-specific native handles, and omit or safely substitute secret material. An export MUST identify non-portable omissions.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-007 Application, uploader, and workflow JSON
nodes.norm_label: compcat-007 application, uploader, and workflow json
nodes.rationale: Application, uploader, and workflow JSON MUST preserve stable semantic IDs rather than runtime type names; validate values and references; and define upgrade, downgrade, enum, path, color, geometry, and collection behavior independently of serializer defaults.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-008 Legacy secret stores
nodes.rationale: Legacy secret stores MUST be treated as sensitive even when unencrypted. Migration MUST require explicit consent, use native secure storage, verify before removal, redact all reporting, and never re-export the plaintext through ordinary configuration compatibility.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-009 History JSON, XML, and SQLite imports
nodes.norm_label: compcat-009 history json, xml, and sqlite imports
nodes.rationale: History JSON, XML, and SQLite imports MUST preserve stable task identity, timestamps, operation state, URLs, local output references, and privacy classification where representable; tolerate missing media; and quarantine corrupt records without discarding valid neighbors.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-010 SQLite compatibility
nodes.rationale: SQLite compatibility MUST operate on a consistent snapshot, validate schema and integrity, avoid executing triggers or extensions from an untrusted database, bound resource use, and record transaction-level failure.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-011 SXCU custom-uploader import
nodes.rationale: SXCU custom-uploader import MUST treat templates, regex, headers, bodies, URLs, and scripts as untrusted data; separate credentials; validate network targets; and require explicit review before enabling external requests or any executable transformation.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-012 Plugin package compatibility
nodes.rationale: Plugin package compatibility MUST verify provenance and manifest schema, enumerate requested authority, prevent path traversal and native-library escape during inspection, and require explicit reviewed installation into the isolated plugin host.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-013 ImageEditor document and effect compatibility
nodes.norm_label: compcat-013 imageeditor document and effect compatibility
nodes.rationale: ImageEditor document and effect compatibility MUST preserve canvas geometry, layer and annotation order, stable tool/effect IDs, parameters, colors, fonts, assets, and metadata policy. Unknown effects or missing resources MUST remain inspectable and use an explicit degraded result rather than silently flattening or discarding editable content.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-014 MCP automation JSON
nodes.rationale: MCP automation JSON MUST use versioned stable tool and resource identifiers, MUST NOT deserialize authority or human consent from untrusted text, and MUST validate each operation against current schemas and policy before it can be invoked.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-015 Malformed, deeply nested, oversized, cyclic, compressed, duplicate-key, invalid-encoding, and path-traversal inputs
nodes.norm_label: compcat-015 malformed, deeply nested, oversized, cyclic, compressed, duplicate-key, invalid-encoding, and path-traversal inputs
nodes.rationale: Malformed, deeply nested, oversized, cyclic, compressed, duplicate-key, invalid-encoding, and path-traversal inputs MUST be bounded and rejected safely without excessive resource use, code execution, network access, or disclosure of local data.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-016 Time, locale, numeric, case-sensitivity, path, newline, and Unicode differences
nodes.norm_label: compcat-016 time, locale, numeric, case-sensitivity, path, newline, and unicode differences
nodes.rationale: Time, locale, numeric, case-sensitivity, path, newline, and Unicode differences MUST have canonical rules and cross-platform fixtures. Import on one supported platform MUST NOT make data unreadable on another without an explicit non-portable disposition.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-017 A migration
nodes.rationale: A migration MUST be repeatable or detect prior completion, preserve an approved rollback or source backup until verification, and record format versions and redacted outcomes. Retrying MUST NOT duplicate accounts, workflows, history entries, annotations, or remote side effects.

nodes.label: COMPCAT-018 Activation
nodes.rationale: Activation MUST include golden fixtures from every supported legacy format and version, corrupt and adversarial fixtures, unknown-field and unknown-record cases, upgrade and downgrade, cross-platform round-trip, secret redaction, idempotent migration, and runtime-observation evidence.

nodes.label: Declarative provider field schemas
nodes.rationale: Provider-controlled code never executes in the trusted UI.

nodes.label: IFCAT-001
nodes.rationale: Every interface-ledger row linked to this package MUST retain its stable ledger ID and receive an approved surface ID, semantic operation, request and result shape, authority, errors, accessibility behavior, and Windows, macOS, and Linux disposition before activation.

nodes.label: IFCAT-002
nodes.rationale: GUI, CLI, MCP, and provider surfaces MUST invoke shared product operations rather than reimplement product behavior. Equivalent requests MUST produce equivalent domain results, side effects, and redacted errors.

nodes.label: IFCAT-003
nodes.rationale: GUI surfaces MUST define initial, loading, populated, empty, validation-error, permission-denied, dependency-unavailable, partial-success, and terminal-failure states where applicable, without relying on color alone.

nodes.label: IFCAT-004
nodes.rationale: Every GUI surface MUST support complete keyboard navigation, visible focus, logical reading order, accessible names and descriptions, screen-reader state changes, text scaling, high contrast, reduced motion, and platform-native input conventions.

nodes.label: IFCAT-005
nodes.rationale: Modal dialogs MUST trap focus only while active, identify their purpose, expose safe default and cancel actions, restore focus on close, and MUST NOT hide destructive consequences or permission prompts behind generic confirmation text.

nodes.label: IFCAT-006
nodes.rationale: Long-running surfaces MUST expose progress when knowable, indeterminate state otherwise, cooperative cancellation, background behavior, and a terminal result that remains available after transient UI closes.

nodes.label: IFCAT-007
nodes.rationale: Layout MUST remain operable under supported scaling, localization expansion, right-to-left text where supported, reduced window size, display topology change, and native font substitution. Essential controls MUST NOT become unreachable.

nodes.label: IFCAT-008
nodes.rationale: CLI commands MUST have stable names, argument and environment precedence, help, stdout and stderr ownership, exit codes, signal handling, non-interactive behavior, and a versioned machine-readable output mode.

nodes.label: IFCAT-009
nodes.rationale: CLI commands MUST NOT prompt when non-interactive mode is selected. Missing consent, credentials, permission, or destructive approval MUST return a distinct actionable result without performing the operation.

nodes.label: IFCAT-010
nodes.rationale: CLI output containing secrets, private paths, capture content, account data, or tokens MUST be redacted by default. Verbose and diagnostic modes MUST NOT weaken redaction.

nodes.label: IFCAT-011
nodes.rationale: MCP tools MUST publish versioned input and output schemas, precise side-effect and authority descriptions, bounded results, progress and cancellation behavior, stable error codes, and explicit destructive-action or external-publication annotations.

nodes.label: IFCAT-012
nodes.rationale: MCP execution MUST apply least authority, distinguish agent request from human consent, reject authority hidden in free-form text, and require human review for credential changes, external publication, destructive operations, plugin installation, or policy-defined sensitive capture and history access.

nodes.label: IFCAT-013
nodes.rationale: MCP capture, history, settings, annotation, and upload surfaces MUST minimize returned private data, support metadata-only discovery where useful, redact secrets, and never expose raw local content beyond the granted scope and result lifetime.

nodes.label: IFCAT-014
nodes.rationale: Destination-provider surfaces MUST use a versioned field schema with stable field IDs, types, validation, secret classification, help, conditional visibility, and authentication actions. Presentation MUST NOT be derived by executing provider-controlled code in the trusted UI process.

nodes.label: IFCAT-015
nodes.rationale: Provider connection tests and authentication MUST be explicit, cancellable network actions. Ordinary configuration viewing and validation MUST NOT transmit credentials or content.

nodes.label: IFCAT-016
nodes.rationale: Interface errors MUST map stable domain error codes to native presentation and MUST preserve correlation IDs without exposing stack traces, secrets, or private payloads. Retrying MUST be offered only when safe.

nodes.label: IFCAT-017
nodes.rationale: Interface availability MUST follow capability and platform disposition. An unavailable native integration MUST expose the approved equivalent, degraded explanation, or explicit absence; a visible but inert control is not an acceptable disposition.

nodes.label: IFCAT-018
nodes.rationale: Activation MUST include semantic equivalence tests across entry points, full keyboard and screen-reader review, scaling and localization, malformed input, permission and credential denial, cancellation, redaction, CLI snapshot and exit-code tests, MCP schema and authority tests, provider field fixtures, and all three native platform adapters.

nodes.label: MCP least authority
nodes.rationale: Agent request cannot manufacture human consent, credentials or external-publication approval.

nodes.label: Shared GUI CLI MCP provider operations
nodes.norm_label: shared gui cli mcp provider operations
nodes.rationale: Equivalent requests must produce equivalent results, side effects and redacted errors.

nodes.label: Owned canvas mutation preparation and rotation previews
nodes.norm_label: owned canvas mutation preparation and rotation previews
nodes.rationale: Workers own immutable values and cancellation state, keeping QtCore validation separate from native codec/UI work.

nodes.label: Native capture Crop and verified source handoff
nodes.norm_label: native capture crop and verified source handoff
nodes.rationale: A declared source region is independently reproduced and byte/dimension-verified before returned annotations can be rendered.

nodes.label: Capture source-history lifetime and publication
nodes.rationale: Cancelled jobs retire immediately without joining; publication checks exact adjacent target identity and retains original Core document.

nodes.label: EDITOR-EFFECTS-001
nodes.rationale: Approved contract; activation still requires conformance and specialist/platform evidence.

nodes.label: EDITOR-EFFECTS-001 Image effects
nodes.rationale: Approved contract; activation still requires conformance and specialist/platform evidence.

nodes.label: EE-001 The approved effect set
nodes.rationale: The approved effect set MUST be the 232 stable IDs selected by `effect-catalog-selection.json` from the pinned inventory: 32 adjustments, 16 drawings, 149 filters, and 35 manipulations. Approval MUST review the ID set and any correction, omission, or native substitution explicitly.

nodes.label: EE-002 Effect IDs
nodes.rationale: Effect IDs MUST remain stable across display-name, localization, icon, menu, or implementation changes. The browser MUST support category, search, recent, and favorite discovery without duplicating an ID.

nodes.label: EE-003 Every parameter
nodes.rationale: Every parameter MUST have a stable ID, type, default, allowed range or choices, validation rule, accessibility label, and serialization form. Invalid, missing, and unknown values MUST produce defined fallback or typed failure behavior and MUST NOT be silently clamped unless specified.

nodes.label: EE-004 A previewable effect
nodes.rationale: A previewable effect MUST preserve the pre-preview document, update a cancellable non-authoritative preview, and commit exactly one history operation only after Apply. Cancel MUST restore the exact prior state.

nodes.label: EE-005 An immediate effect
nodes.rationale: An immediate effect MUST either be safely reversible through one history entry or obtain explicit confirmation before an irreversible external action. Failure MUST leave pixels, annotations, history, and dirty state as they were before invocation.

nodes.label: EE-007 Effects requiring images, fonts, maps, masks, models, or other assets
nodes.norm_label: ee-007 effects requiring images, fonts, maps, masks, models, or other assets
nodes.rationale: Effects requiring images, fonts, maps, masks, models, or other assets MUST validate type and size before decode, surface missing-asset failures, and embed or durably reference assets required for reproducibility.

nodes.label: EE-008 Random or procedural effects
nodes.rationale: Random or procedural effects MUST expose or derive a persisted seed. Identical normalized input, parameters, seed, renderer version, and color profile MUST produce identical decoded pixels on all platforms.

nodes.label: EE-009 Effect execution
nodes.rationale: Effect execution MUST define alpha, premultiplication, color-space, orientation, edge sampling, and clipping behavior and MUST avoid unintended conversion to an opaque or lower-fidelity image.

nodes.label: EE-010 Expensive effects
nodes.rationale: Expensive effects MUST expose progress and cancellation, honor memory and dimension limits, release abandoned previews, and MUST NOT publish a partial result after cancellation or resource exhaustion.

nodes.label: EE-011 Applying a new effect after undo
nodes.norm_label: ee-011 applying a new effect after undo
nodes.rationale: Applying a new effect after undo MUST clear the redo branch. A preview MUST NOT enter history, dirty the document, or alter recent-effects ordering until it commits successfully.

nodes.label: EE-012 Recent and favorite lists
nodes.rationale: Recent and favorite lists MUST contain stable effect IDs, reject duplicates, retain deterministic ordering, tolerate unknown retired IDs, and remain user-editable without changing the effect catalog.

nodes.label: EE-013 Search and categories
nodes.rationale: Search and categories MUST be keyboard and screen-reader operable; parameter controls MUST expose names, values, units, ranges, errors, and reset-to-default actions using native accessibility APIs.

nodes.label: EE-014 The UI
nodes.rationale: The UI MAY use accelerated or lower-resolution previews, but Apply and export MUST use the authoritative renderer. Preview differences MUST be bounded and disclosed for effects where exact live preview is impractical.

nodes.label: EE-015 Unknown compatible effect IDs and parameters in imported presets
nodes.norm_label: ee-015 unknown compatible effect ids and parameters in imported presets
nodes.rationale: Unknown compatible effect IDs and parameters in imported presets MUST be retained for round-trip and shown as unsupported; they MUST NOT invoke reflection, scripts, network access, or arbitrary constructors.

nodes.label: EE-016 Effects
nodes.rationale: Effects MUST operate locally unless a separately approved service contract explicitly requires network use. User pixels, parameters, asset paths, and previews MUST NOT leave the device without explicit user action.

nodes.label: EE-017 Conformance
nodes.rationale: Conformance MUST enumerate every selected ID and prove it is constructible, uniquely identified, categorized, parameter-validatable, and either previewable or immediate as declared. Representative golden images MUST cover every algorithm family and all boundary-value parameter classes.

nodes.label: EE-018 Unsupported hardware, codecs, fonts, or accelerators
nodes.norm_label: ee-018 unsupported hardware, codecs, fonts, or accelerators
nodes.rationale: Unsupported hardware, codecs, fonts, or accelerators MUST result in a deterministic CPU/native fallback or an approved platform disposition with a user-visible diagnostic; silent omission from the browser is prohibited.

nodes.label: Progressive commit and final push protocol
nodes.norm_label: progressive commit and final push protocol

nodes.label: Native editor save and companion repair
nodes.norm_label: native editor save and companion repair
nodes.rationale: Descriptor-bound PNG/companion persistence records an immutable history checkpoint; partial saves remain dirty and only live receipts authorize repair.

nodes.label: Native paired capture persistence
nodes.rationale: Explicit per-run companion intent freezes with accepted annotations; partial PNG success permits companion-only repair but no delete/restart authority.

nodes.label: Native saved-file outputs
nodes.rationale: File consumers require successful selected save and validate live descriptor-derived identity; persisted metadata cannot recreate consumption authority.

nodes.label: Native capture result journal and recovery
nodes.norm_label: native capture result journal and recovery
nodes.rationale: Metadata-only recovery observes unknown pending outcomes without reconstructing pixels, file authority or automatic retry.

nodes.label: EDITOR-SETTINGS-001
nodes.rationale: Approved contract; activation still requires conformance and specialist/platform evidence.

nodes.label: EDITOR-SETTINGS-001 Editor settings
nodes.rationale: Approved contract; activation still requires conformance and specialist/platform evidence.

nodes.label: ESET-001 Every persisted ImageEditor option in the settings ledger
nodes.norm_label: eset-001 every persisted imageeditor option in the settings ledger
nodes.rationale: Every persisted ImageEditor option in the settings ledger MUST receive a stable contract name, type, default, validation, migration, privacy classification, supported-platform disposition, and downstream-effect description before this package can become active.

nodes.label: ESET-002 Loading
nodes.rationale: Loading MUST distinguish missing, valid, unknown, invalid, and newer-version fields. Invalid values MUST fall back per field with a visible diagnostic or recovery record and MUST NOT reset unrelated valid settings.

nodes.label: ESET-003 Saving
nodes.rationale: Saving MUST be atomic, retain compatible unknown fields, avoid writing computed/color convenience properties marked non-persistent, and keep a recoverable previous version according to the configuration policy.

nodes.label: ESET-004 Theme, system-theme, accent, and system-accent preferences
nodes.norm_label: eset-004 theme, system-theme, accent, and system-accent preferences
nodes.rationale: Theme, system-theme, accent, and system-accent preferences MUST resolve predictably on all platforms and MUST preserve contrast, focus, high-contrast, reduced-motion, and screen-reader requirements.

nodes.label: ESET-005 Remembered window size and maximized state
nodes.norm_label: eset-005 remembered window size and maximized state
nodes.rationale: Remembered window size and maximized state MUST be clamped to an available display, adapt to changed display topology or scaling, and MUST NOT strand the window off screen. Disabling memory MUST stop persistence.

nodes.label: ESET-006 Last tool, shared border/fill/thickness/corner/border/arrow/cursor choices, shadow fields, and all text, balloon, step, emphasis, and redaction defaults
nodes.norm_label: eset-006 last tool, shared border/fill/thickness/corner/border/arrow/cursor choices, shadow fields, and all text, balloon, step, emphasis, and redaction defaults
nodes.rationale: Last tool, shared border/fill/thickness/corner/border/arrow/cursor choices, shadow fields, and all text, balloon, step, emphasis, and redaction defaults MUST affect only subsequently created objects unless the user edits a current selection explicitly.

nodes.label: ESET-007 Colors
nodes.rationale: Colors MUST persist in an alpha-preserving, locale-independent canonical representation. Invalid colors MUST use the field default and emit a field-specific recovery diagnostic.

nodes.label: ESET-008 Font family, size, weight, italic, alignment, and step-style preferences
nodes.norm_label: eset-008 font family, size, weight, italic, alignment, and step-style preferences
nodes.rationale: Font family, size, weight, italic, alignment, and step-style preferences MUST validate against usable native fonts and ranges. Missing fonts MUST use an accessible fallback without rewriting the user's preference until they explicitly save a replacement.

nodes.label: ESET-009 Blur, pixelate, magnifier, spotlight, background geometry, shadow, and related numeric values
nodes.norm_label: eset-009 blur, pixelate, magnifier, spotlight, background geometry, shadow, and related numeric values
nodes.rationale: Blur, pixelate, magnifier, spotlight, background geometry, shadow, and related numeric values MUST reject non-finite input and enforce documented inclusive ranges consistently in UI, config import, and automation.

nodes.label: ESET-010 Toolbar items
nodes.rationale: Toolbar items MUST use stable action IDs, visibility, group, and hotkey fields; validation MUST reject duplicate action placements where not supported, invalid hotkeys, unsafe reserved gestures, and unknown actions while retaining unknown compatible entries for round-trip.

nodes.label: ESET-011 Toolbar customization
nodes.rationale: Toolbar customization MUST support reorder, show/hide, grouping, hotkey assignment, reset to defaults, Cancel without persistence, and Apply as one atomic preference change. Essential escape/recovery actions MUST remain reachable even if hidden from the toolbar.

nodes.label: ESET-012 Recent image paths
nodes.rationale: Recent image paths MUST be opt-in private local data, de-duplicated using platform path rules, bounded by a validated maximum, removable singly or in full, resilient to missing files, and excluded from telemetry/support data.

nodes.label: ESET-013 Recent and favorite effects
nodes.rationale: Recent and favorite effects MUST persist stable effect IDs, retain order, remove duplicates, tolerate retired IDs, and initialize defaults without re-adding an effect the user intentionally removed.

nodes.label: ESET-014 Auto-copy, auto-close, quick-crop, insert-dialog, notification, zoom-to-fit, and exit-confirmation preferences
nodes.norm_label: eset-014 auto-copy, auto-close, quick-crop, insert-dialog, notification, zoom-to-fit, and exit-confirmation preferences
nodes.rationale: Auto-copy, auto-close, quick-crop, insert-dialog, notification, zoom-to-fit, and exit-confirmation preferences MUST never bypass required consent, destructive confirmation, permissions, validation, or error reporting.

nodes.label: ESET-015 Settings conformance
nodes.rationale: Settings conformance MUST exercise the vectors in `test-vectors.json`, every field's default and invalid boundary, upgrades from supported versions, unknown-field round-trip, atomic failure, and all three platform adapters before activation.

nodes.label: ESET-016 The actions and precedence in `shortcut-catalog.json`
nodes.norm_label: eset-016 the actions and precedence in `shortcut-catalog.json`
nodes.rationale: The actions and precedence in `shortcut-catalog.json` MUST remain available through native-equivalent gestures and visible command surfaces. macOS MAY substitute Command for Control. Text entry and modal dialogs MUST take precedence over editor shortcuts, and user-defined tool hotkeys MUST be validated for collisions with protected actions.

nodes.label: RFC 2119 normative behavior
nodes.rationale: - **CONTRACT-NORM-001** Use RFC 2119 keywords. MUST/MUST NOT are required behavior; SHOULD has a documented exception path; MAY is optional.

nodes.label: SemVer contract version
nodes.rationale: - **CONTRACT-VERSION-001** Versioning follows SemVer as in BXIP001 §7.4. The contract version is the product version native apps may claim.

nodes.label: Stable requirement identifiers
nodes.rationale: - **CONTRACT-ID-001** Requirement IDs are stable and never reused for a different meaning. Capability directories are `<AREA>-<SLUG>-<NNN>/`.

nodes.rationale: Owns native realizations of the Product Contract on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. Does not own the contract, shared expected results, or release approval.

nodes.rationale: Owns the native Linux editions under D-LIN-001 and D-LIN-002. `linux-qt` is the supported reference edition.

nodes.rationale: - **LINUX-CORE-001** Product logic that has a conformance seam lives in `linux-qt/src/` libraries that depend only on Qt Core, so the adapter and the application share one production code path.

nodes.label: RC-001
nodes.rationale: Before showing an overlay, the implementation MUST determine whether screen capture is authorized, denied, restricted, or requires a native prompt. It MUST NOT show a misleading selectable desktop when pixels cannot be acquired.

nodes.label: RC-002
nodes.rationale: A first authorization request MUST use the operating system's native consent flow. Denial MUST return diagnostic `capture-permission-denied` with a native route to settings where available; it MUST NOT loop prompts.

nodes.label: RC-003
nodes.rationale: The implementation MUST snapshot monitor bounds, scale, rotation, stable display identity, color characteristics, and capture availability for the session. Topology change during selection MUST cancel with diagnostic `display-topology-changed` or restart only after explicit user confirmation.

nodes.label: RC-004
nodes.rationale: Logical-to-physical mapping MUST be defined per monitor edge and MUST produce the same half-open physical rectangle as the vectors. The implementation MUST NOT apply one monitor's scale to another monitor.

nodes.label: RC-005
nodes.rationale: The overlay MUST cover every capturable display without appearing in the captured result. It MUST preserve the user's ability to see the source desktop, either as a frozen snapshot or through a live transparent surface.

nodes.label: RC-006
nodes.rationale: Press-drag-release MUST create a rectangle from any drag direction. The normalized rectangle MUST have positive width and height before it can be confirmed.

nodes.label: RC-007
nodes.rationale: With quick confirmation enabled, pointer release over a positive selection MUST confirm it. With quick confirmation disabled, release MUST enter `selected` and Enter or an accessible confirm action MUST confirm it.

nodes.label: RC-008
nodes.rationale: Escape or the native cancel action MUST cancel from every non-terminal state. Cancellation MUST return no image, MUST NOT update the last-region setting, and MUST NOT start post-capture actions.

nodes.label: RC-009
nodes.rationale: Enter MUST confirm only a positive current selection. A click with no drag MAY select a detected window or control when snapping is enabled; otherwise it MUST NOT capture an accidental one-pixel region.

nodes.label: RC-010
nodes.rationale: Arrow-key movement and resize, resize handles, and optional size presets MUST remain clamped to the capturable desktop. Shift or the native precision modifier MAY change step size but MUST be documented in the UI.

nodes.label: RC-011
nodes.rationale: Window/control snapping MAY use native discovery and native hover mechanics. The resulting physical bounds MUST be visible before confirmation and users MUST be able to override snapping by dragging freely.

nodes.label: RC-012
nodes.rationale: The output bitmap dimensions MUST equal the confirmed rectangle's physical width and height. Cross-monitor capture MUST composite source pixels in desktop physical order without gaps, duplication, or scale resampling.

nodes.label: RC-013
nodes.rationale: Cursor inclusion is an explicit setting. When enabled, the cursor MUST be drawn once at its physical position and hotspot relative to the selection. Selection UI, magnifier, handles, toolbars, and crosshairs MUST NOT appear in output.

nodes.label: RC-014
nodes.rationale: Frozen capture MUST represent a single session snapshot. Live capture MAY reflect later source changes, but the UI MUST identify live mode before confirmation.

nodes.label: RC-015
nodes.rationale: HDR and wide-gamut input MUST use a documented conversion to the workflow output color space. Silent clipping, double tone mapping, or per-monitor color inconsistency is prohibited.

nodes.label: RC-016
nodes.rationale: A completed selection MUST publish exactly one result. Repeated pointer, keyboard, window-close, or monitor events after terminal transition MUST be ignored.

nodes.label: RC-017
nodes.rationale: The last-region value MUST update atomically only after capture pixels are acquired successfully. Its persisted representation MUST include enough display identity and normalized geometry to detect an invalid later topology.

nodes.label: RC-018
nodes.rationale: Permission, portal, capture-source, and mapping failures MUST have stable diagnostic codes and MUST retain no screen pixels beyond the configured privacy/diagnostic policy.

nodes.label: RC-019
nodes.rationale: The overlay MUST expose screen-reader instructions, visible focus, keyboard-only selection/confirmation/cancellation, high-contrast boundaries, and non-color-only state cues.

nodes.label: RC-020
nodes.rationale: Pointer feedback SHOULD remain at display refresh rate and SHOULD show selection changes within 50 ms at the 95th percentile. Confirmation to pixel result SHOULD complete within 250 ms for a 1920x1080 region, excluding an operating-system portal chooser.

nodes.label: RC-021
nodes.rationale: Implementations MUST pass the mapping and state vectors in `test-vectors.json`.

nodes.label: RC-022
nodes.rationale: A logical point on display D MUST map to desktop physical space as `D.physical.left + (x - D.logical.left) * D.scale` and `D.physical.top + (y - D.logical.top) * D.scale`, computed in IEEE 754 double precision and then rounded with `floor(value + 0.000001)`. A pointer position MUST be mapped on the display that reports it. The normalized selection is `left = min(x0, x1)`, `right = max(x0, x1)`, `top = min(y0, y1)`, and `bottom = max(y0, y1)` of the two mapped points, so the end point is the exclusive edge.

nodes.label: RC-023
nodes.rationale: Mapped points MUST be clamped to the reporting display's physical bounds, where the right and bottom edges are valid exclusive rectangle edges. Keyboard and handle adjustments MUST keep the rectangle inside the bounding box of all capturable displays. Output pixels inside the rectangle that no capturable display covers MUST be transparent black (all channels zero).

nodes.label: RC-024
nodes.rationale: A keyboard move or resize step MUST be 1 physical pixel, and 10 physical pixels with the native precision modifier. A move that would cross the bounding box MUST stop at the edge and preserve size. A resize MUST keep width and height at least 1 physical pixel. Each step is one selection change; the resulting bounds MUST be announced to assistive technology.

nodes.label: RC-025
nodes.rationale: The session state machine MUST process these events: `permission` (`authorized`, `denied`, `restricted`), `ready`, `pointer-down`, `pointer-move`, `pointer-up`, `key-enter`, `key-escape`, `confirm`, `cancel`, `topology-changed`, `capture-succeeded`, and `capture-failed`. An event with no transition in `STATE_MACHINE.md` MUST be ignored. Denied or restricted permission MUST enter `failed` with `capture-permission-denied` without showing an overlay. `capture-failed` MUST enter `failed` with `capture-source-failed`.

nodes.label: RC-026
nodes.rationale: With snapping disabled, a pointer-down and pointer-up at the same physical point MUST leave the session `idle`. With snapping enabled and a detected window or control under the pointer, the same click MUST select that element's clamped physical bounds and then follow RC-007.

nodes.label: RC-027
nodes.rationale: The persisted last region MUST record format version 1, the normalized physical rectangle, and the stable ID and physical bounds of every display the rectangle intersects. A later last-region capture MUST fail with `last-region-invalid`, without capturing, when any recorded display is missing or its physical bounds changed.

nodes.norm_label: core-007 tray, main-window, hotkey, notification, and command-palette surfaces
nodes.rationale: Tray, main-window, hotkey, notification, and command-palette surfaces MUST invoke shared operations, expose current availability, remain keyboard accessible, and MUST NOT present inert actions as successful.
